MCSR SHOW ENEMY

Stream overlay for MCSR Ranked

OBS BROWSER SOURCE

http://localhost:3001

How to use

1. Enter your Minecraft nick and press SAVE
2. Press COPY to copy the overlay link
3. In OBS: Sources → + → Browser → paste the link
4. Play MCSR Ranked — opponent card appears automatically!
5. Press TEST to preview the card
